To be properly hydrated, you have to drink more than plain water. Hydration depends on a balance of water and essential minerals, known as electrolytes, that your body loses every day. Ancestral Electrolytes were created for people who wanted a cleaner hydration option without the artificial ingredients found in many popular electrolyte products or sports beverages. Our formula delivers meaningful amounts of sodium, chloride, potassium, and magnesium sourced from Celtic Sea Salt, red marine algae, and marine magnesium, along with choline, an essential nutrient that most electrolyte products leave out. It's made without any added sugar, artificial dyes, or fillers—only ancestral-inspired ingredients to help you feel your best.
